main_text.head: Cap.I. 1. Ad Corinthios.
main_text.p: POst triplicem salutationem in nouem primis versibus occurrentem, quorum tres primi benè precantur in præsens.
Vers. 1. Paulus vocatus Apostolus Iesu Christi per voluntatē dei et Sosthenes frater
2 Ecclesiæ dei quæ est Corinthi, sanctificatis in Christo Iesu, vocatis sanctis, cum omnibus invocantibus nomen domini nostri Iesu Christi in omni loco ipsorum q; & nostro.
3 Gratia vobis & pax à deo patre nostro, & domino Iesu Christo.
Sequentes quatuor de donis hactenus acceptis deo gratias agunt, & ipsis Corinthiis gratulantur.
4 Gratias ago deo meo semper de gratia Dei data vobis in Christo Iesu.
5 Quod in omnibus ditati estis, in omni sermone, & in omni scientia. 6 Sicut testimonium Christi confirmatum est in vobis.
7 Adeò ut non destituamini in vllo dono, ex- pectantes revelationem domini nostri Iesu Christi.
Vt reliqui duo eos in posterum bene spe- rare iubent.
8 Qui etiam confirmabit vos inculpatos in die domini nostri Iesu Christi.
9 Fidelis Deus per quem vocati estis ad com- munionem filij ipsius domini nostri Iesu Christi.

page.notes: The first word of the page is a large woodcut-style initial P. Several words in italic are struck or underlined in the scan (e.g. "Quod" underlined). The line "Gratias ago" appears with a marginal flourish. The scan is cut off after the last line; the continuation is in part 2. Fragments of marginal notes at the far left are cut off and unreadable, so not transcribed. The signature line "A." and "Iplam" sit on one line, the latter at the right, probably a catchword-like closing of the verse, kept as a paragraph. Some words in the italic verse text are uncertain.
